# General Instructions for Problem Sets

The goal of the problem sets is to give you practice thinking about and working with the concepts that we are covering. You should work alone on this assignment but may freely consult course resources and search the internet (but don't use AI to answer questions).

Before completing a problem set, you should review the content videos for the week and it may be helpful to complete those before the related class periods as well.

Use the link at the top of this page to turn in your completed assignment. Problem Sets are due on Sundays.
